description: Main implementation for fine-tuning API, including functions for creating, listing, retrieving, and canceling fine-tuning jobs across multiple providers (OpenAI, Azure, Vertex AI). It handles both synchronous and asynchronous calls, manages configuration via environment variables and parameters, and interacts with external APIs via imported API handler instances.
